route: Written permission of the Island Council

permit.applies: the worker, to the Island Council
permit.first: entry clearance for a stay over 14 days (NZ$150), and the Island Council's written permission before work begins

fees.what: entry clearance application fee, stay over 14 days and under 6 months (non-refundable)

sources.title: Visit Pitcairn (Pitcairn Islands Tourism), Visa and legal requirements
sources.said: If your visit is for longer than 14 days but less than 6 months you must complete an entry clearance application form well in advance of your visit (at least 3 months is recommended). A NZ$150.00 non-refundable fee is required. … Do I need a visa to work on Pitcairn? Yes, if you have not been granted a settlement visa and are not a permanent resident of Pitcairn you need to obtain written permission from the Island Council before taking up paid employment or entering business on Pitcairn. More info at Para 16 of Immigration Ordinance 2006.

note: Pitcairn (Visit Pitcairn, repeating the Pitcairn Islands Government's information): anyone without a settlement visa or permanent residence needs the Island Council's written permission before taking paid employment (Immigration Control Ordinance 2006, para. 16). A stay over 14 days and under six months needs entry clearance with a NZ$150 non-refundable fee, applied for at least three months ahead as recommended; the work permission's own fee, decision time and term aren't stated. No exempt days.
